column2: Ian is gone. He owned 3 functions on the old map (25.0 training, 29.0 QC gate, 32.0 packing). All three are re-homed — QC to Justin, packing and catching to Kim.

Production scheduling split in two. 21.0 is the WEEK (Richie). 22.0 is the DAY (Justin). This is the Planner / Executioner structure and it is the single biggest change on the map.
The CX seat was never hired and is not coming. Clint holds Customer Success. Every 'CX (Luke interim)' line now has a real name.
